union_claim.statement: Across the reported Windows runs and the observed Linux run, every one of the 198 top-level test cases passed at least once with zero failures or errors. The claim is derived from reported Windows evidence plus observed Linux evidence.
limits: This is coverage across the specific reported and observed runs only; it does not establish that every test passes on every OS or Python version.
No subtest, branch, or platform-behavior coverage is claimed.
It does not claim single-environment union coverage is unachievable; a Windows host with symlink privilege could plausibly run all 198.
